desc: Miles Rapore's old flute, used to decorate the soundscapes of the Honeydews' many musical performances. He's often credited with keeping the band together, but his reclusive attitude towards crowds and stringent focus on marketability earned him a bad reputation.

A fine drum with a patterned leather cover, famously owned by Daniel the Damned, a former member of the Honeydews. Fans speculated that tha back of the drum was inscribed with runes that would make Daniel play faster, like a possessed man.

Now that you're holding it, those rumors proves to be false but his damnation was very real, at least!
This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.
obtain: Found in the Veilwater Basin at the Cargo Lift.

desc: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of the Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.

An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of the Honeydews the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftmanship of the instrument are well preserved.
